title: Direct-image composition respects the inverse-isomorphism units on the pro-etale site
statement:
Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $J:X\to Y$ a morphism, and $a:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X$, $b:Y\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ scheme isomorphisms such that $J\circ a=b\circ J$. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the direct images of abelian sheaves of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], namely evaluation after base change. Write products of functors in functional order. Put
$$R=J_*,\quad A=a_*,\quad B=b_*,\quad P=(a^{-1})_*,\quad Q=(b^{-1})_*.$$
Use the canonical composition comparisons $v_*u_*\cong(v\circ u)_*$ induced by isomorphisms of iterated fibre products. The equalities $J a=bJ$ and $J a^{-1}=b^{-1}J$ give the specified comparisons
$$C:RA\xrightarrow{\sim}BR,\qquad d:QR\xrightarrow{\sim}RP.$$
Explicitly, $C$ goes through $(J a)_*=(bJ)_*$ and $d$ through $(b^{-1}J)_*=(J a^{-1})_*$. Let $\nu^a:\mathrm{id}\to AP$ and $\nu^b:\mathrm{id}\to BQ$ be the inverses of the canonical composition-and-identity comparisons $AP\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $BQ\cong\mathrm{id}$, respectively. For every abelian sheaf $M$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ one has
$$C_{PM}\circ R(\nu^a_M)=B(d_M)\circ\nu^b_{RM}:RM\longrightarrow BRPM.$$
All the displayed maps use the chosen fibre products and their canonical universal-property isomorphisms; no strict equality between iterated fibre products is assumed.
